title: tk cloud run, stop and status: the terminal rung of the command surface
description: UC1b D21 on the CLI side, mirroring the tk herd verb family. tk cloud run <epic> pushes the current branch, REFUSES if the epic tick files are not on the remote (the submission boundary is a pushed SHA, D3), then POSTs to the factory with the token from ~/.ticksrc via internal/ticksrc. Flags: --notify to pick the channel per submission, --queue for D22. tk cloud stop <run> and tk cloud status. There is deliberately NO mid-run mutation verb and none is to be added: steering is stop, edit the tracker, run again, riding the reconcile path. Read the endpoint and token through internal/ticksrc, never bespoke file access. A missing factory config is an actionable stop naming tk factory setup.
